extension.summary: Pick from the last 10 things you played in Kodi
extension.description: Remembers what you play (local files, network shares, and streams from other add-ons) and lets you choose from the last 10 items. Resumes where you stopped, with the same subtitle you were using. Works as a skin widget (Video add-ons > Last Played 10). Independent from the one-click "Last Played" add-on.

extension.summary: Your Premiumize cloud as a Kodi library, with artwork and IMDb ratings
extension.description: Syncs the videos in your Premiumize cloud into Kodi as .strm files with NFO metadata (posters, fanart, plot, cast, IMDb and TMDb ratings), so they appear in Movies and TV Shows like local files. Playback asks Premiumize for a fresh link each time. Also includes a browse view of the raw cloud folders and a manual match tool for files that cannot be identified automatically, and automatic English subtitles from OpenSubtitles.com for videos that have none. Requires a Premiumize account, a free TMDb API key, and (for IMDb ratings) a free OMDb API key.
extension.news: 1.4.4 - Long-press a movie, episode or TV show in the Kodi library (or a file in this add-on) and choose "Delete from Premiumize": asks first, then deletes the videos, their subtitles and the leftover download folder from the cloud and removes them from the library. 1.4.3 - Locked settings come from the public delivery repository (SJJ Kodi Repository 1.1.0); stronger lock and PINs of at least 8 characters. 1.4.2 - Locked settings work with SJJ Kodi Repository 1.0.2 (key sent as a header). 1.4.1 - Locked settings are found with the updated SJJ Kodi Repository (1.0.1). 1.4.0 - New Shields set themselves up: "Create locked settings for new Shields" saves the keys and settings of this add-on and TorrentClaw, locked with your PIN, for your private repository; a new Shield asks for the PIN once and fills everything in (Settings > Sync). 1.3.1 - After each sync, checks that matched films and episodes really are in the Kodi library and asks Kodi to scan again if not. 1.3.0 - Appears in Subtitles > Download: OpenSubtitles results (exact-file matches marked in sync) plus "Sync the current subtitle to the dialogue"; retries dropped connections. 1.2.1 - Tells you when subtitles were skipped because an earlier search found none; "Forget failed subtitle searches" button; clearer subtitle log lines. 1.2.0 - English subtitles fetched from OpenSubtitles.com when a video has none (chosen by file name, exact-file matches first); Export/Import settings. 1.1.0 - Playback through the Premiumize HTTP folder link (found in your Kodi sources), with API fallback; subtitle files next to a video are loaded automatically. 1.0.2 - Unmatched files are retried on every sync; library scans use the path Kodi stores for the source; sync summary in the Kodi log. 1.0.1 - API key fields fixed.

extension.summary: Browse TorrentClaw and many torrent sites, and send torrents to your Premiumize cloud
extension.description: Popular, latest and trending movies and TV shows from TorrentClaw, with search. Long-press any title or release and choose "Add to Premiumize cloud". Fetches English subtitles from OpenSubtitles.com when a release has none. Shows IMDb ratings, release quality, size, seeders, audio languages and Premiumize cache status. Requires a TorrentClaw API key (for magnet links) and a Premiumize API key.
extension.news: 1.8.1 - If a torrent site resets the connection (some internet providers do this to Nyaa, 1337x and LimeTorrents even after the address lookup works), the add-on now tries again with the first secure packet split in two pieces, then split into two TLS records, so the site name is not visible in one piece. Only after a reset, only for the torrent sites; the certificate is still checked. Switch it off in Settings > Torrent sites. A site that still resets now says your internet provider may be blocking it. 1.8.0 - Search All Torrent Sites now looks up each site's address with DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare, with Google as back-up), so it works when your internet provider blocks torrent sites by DNS. Used only for the torrent-site searches, their mirrors and the magnet-page lookups; TorrentClaw, TMDb, Premiumize and playback are untouched. Settings > Torrent sites: switch it off, or pick Google as the first service. The site test now says which lookup is in use. 1.7.1 - In Search All Torrent Sites, text in double quotes is now an exact match: "the night of" lists only releases containing those words together (you can add other words outside the quotes, e.g. "the night of" 2016). Sites that refuse Kodi (HTTP 403, e.g. 1337x) now say so plainly in the site test. 1.7.0 - New main-menu section "Search All Torrent Sites": searches The Pirate Bay, YTS, Nyaa, 1337x, LimeTorrents and Knaben at once, merges the same release found on several sites, hides cinema recordings, marks releases that are already cached on Premiumize, and adds one to your cloud (asks first, files it in your Movies / TV folder). Same searches as before - title, actor, director, author, keyword and the advanced filter - open a title's releases from all the sites; shows list seasons and a specific-episode search. Settings > Torrent sites: switch each site on or off, give a site a new web address when it moves, wait time, minimum seeders, and a "Test the torrent sites" button. 1.6.2 - Author, keyword and watchlist lists keep titles that are not on TorrentClaw (marked "not on TorrentClaw yet") instead of hiding them. 1.6.1 - Search by keyword: type a tag word (time travel, film noir, heist...), pick the TMDb keyword, choose movies / TV / both; best-known titles with it, highest IMDb score first. 1.6.0 - Search by author (Search Movies / Search TV Shows): films and shows based on a writer's novels, stories, screenplays or characters, any language, highest IMDb score first; open a title for its TorrentClaw releases. Long-press any title: Search TorrentClaw for this title, Add to TMDb watchlist, Add to a TMDb list (movies). New My TMDb Watchlist menu, OMDb key setting and TMDb account settings. 1.5.1 - New search now runs straight away after you type the title, instead of only adding it to the history list. 1.5.0 - Advanced filter in Search Movies and Search TV Shows: pick a language (films made in that language's countries, with that audio), a genre and a decade; results sorted by IMDb score. Includes an Art house genre (from TMDb's art house tag, sorted by TMDb score; releases looked up on TorrentClaw when you open a title). Save filters as favourites for one click. 1.4.0 - Search by actor or director in Search Movies and Search TV Shows: pick the person, see their main films/shows highest rated first (from TMDb), releases looked up on TorrentClaw when you open one. 1.3.0 - New East Asian Movies section: best, popular and latest Chinese, Japanese, Hong Kong and Korean films; "Best" lists added to the Indian section too. 1.2.0 - Indian Movies rebuilt: latest and popular Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada films listed from TMDb (releases looked up on TorrentClaw when you open one), plus "Any film with Hindi/Malayalam/... audio". New TMDb API key setting (reuses the Premiumize Library key if empty).

extension.description: Installs and updates Premiumize Library, TorrentClaw, Last Played and Last Played 10 on every Shield.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - Add-ons now come from a public delivery repository, because Kodi cannot install from a private GitHub repository. No key needed. 1.0.2 - Key sent as a header. 1.0.1 - First attempt at sending the key up front.

extension.summary: One click to replay or resume the last thing you played in Kodi
extension.description: Remembers what you play (local files, network shares, and streams from other add-ons) and resumes it in one click, with the same subtitle you were using. For a list of the last 10 items, install the separate "Last Played 10" add-on.
